About Pepagora

Pepagora is a verification-first B2B growth platform helping businesses build trust and expand across global markets. Our technology ecosystem includes TruBadge™, ESR Score™, Janu AI, and OneInbox.

Role Overview

We are looking for a QA Engineer with strong manual testing fundamentals and hands-on experience in **Playwright Automation**. You will be responsible for testing web applications, APIs, and mobile products while ensuring product quality across releases.

* API testing experience using Postman.
* Basic knowledge of Git and GitHub.

Good to Have

* Experience in mobile application testing (Android/iOS).
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automation integration.
* Experience testing live web applications and APIs.

**Work Location:** Coimbatore (Work from Office)

**Note:** Candidates without practical hands-on experience in Playwright Automation will not be considered.

description:

**Locations: Coimbatore**

**QA Automation Engineer**

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a strong hands-on Senior QA Automation Engineer who can design, develop, and maintain a scalable automation framework for our web applications. The candidate should have strong automation fundamentals and should be capable of building automation from the ground up, identifying the right automation approach, troubleshooting failures, and continuously improving the framework as the application evolves.The person will work closely with QA, Development, Product, and DevOps teams.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of overall QA experience
* Minimum 3+ years of strong hands-on automation experience
* Experience building or significantly enhancing an automation framework
* Strong manual testing fundamentals are required

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop a scalable UI automation framework.
* Automate end-to-end business workflows, not only individual screens or test cases.
* Create reusable automation components that can be used across multiple modules.
* Maintain a centralized approach for locators, configurations, test data, and reusable functions.
* Develop automation that can run across different environments such as Dev, QA, Demo, and Production without major code changes.
* Handle dynamic UI elements, waits, asynchronous behaviour, pop-ups, validations, error messages, and complex user workflows.
* Implement stable element identification strategies using IDs, semantic/accessibility properties, roles, labels, text, and other reliable locators.
* Work with Development teams when application changes are required to make the application automation-friendly.
* Develop and maintain API automation wherever applicable.
* Validate UI and API workflows together for complete end-to-end testing.
* Implement cross-browser automation.
* Support data-driven and reusable test automation.
* Integrate automation with CI/CD pipelines.
* Generate clear automation execution reports with pass/fail results, screenshots, logs, and failure reasons.
* Analyse failed automation scripts and identify whether the issue is related to application, test data, environment, or automation code.
* Maintain automation code using Git and follow proper branching and code-review practices.
* Participate in automation planning and identify the right scenarios for regression and smoke automation.
* Support QA team members in understanding and contributing to automation.

* Provident Fund

title: n8n Automation Engineer
description:
**Location:** Remote / Hybrid

**Experience:** 3 to 5 Years

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced **n8n Automation Engineer** with **3–5 years of experience** to build and maintain high-volume automated workflows and WhatsApp Business API integrations. You will connect core systems (CRMs, databases, APIs) to dynamic messaging flows and chatbots.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **n8n Workflow Development:** Build, test, and optimize complex workflows in n8n (custom JS nodes, error handling, sub-workflows).
* **WhatsApp Automation:** Design interactive message flows, button menus, template triggers, and bot logic using Meta Cloud API or BSPs (Twilio, 360dialog, Wati).
* **API & System Integrations:** Connect n8n via REST/GraphQL APIs and webhooks to CRMs (HubSpot, Zoho, GHL), databases (PostgreSQL, Supabase), and payment gateways.
* **Data & Performance:** Handle JSON data transformations, rate limits, error logging, and pipeline uptime.

**Requirements**

* **3–5 years** in automation, software integration, or backend development.
* **2+ years** of direct, hands-on production experience with **n8n**.
* Strong understanding of **WhatsApp Business API** architecture and Meta policies.
* Solid skills in **JavaScript / Node.js** (for n8n function nodes) and **REST APIs / Webhooks**.
* Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases.

**Nice to Have**

* Self-hosting n8n setup (Docker, VPS, Nginx).
* AI/LLM integration experience (OpenAI, Claude) within n8n workflows.

**To Apply:** Send your resume and brief details of past n8n/WhatsApp projects to careers@knowtifics.com
